# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting is currently disabled for this repository. When enabled, use GitHub **Security → Report a vulnerability** as the primary channel.

Until then, email `nexa.business.contact@gmail.com` with subject `[SECURITY][mobile] concise vulnerability title`.

Include repository, version, component, impact, reproduction steps, safe proof of concept, suggested mitigation and investigator availability. Do not send real tokens, passwords, personal data, production data or destructive exploit instructions.

Do not report security issues through public issues. Repository and documentation security reports are still accepted.

## Supported versions

No runtime implementation has been released. Documentation security reports are accepted for the current repository foundation.
